findings.highlight: By midnight last night we managed to work it out.
findings.evidenceJa: 昨夜の零時を以って完全に和解しました
findings.governingReading: Sakura ceremoniously announces complete reconciliation effective at midnight.
findings.explanation: Sakura's formal announcement of reconciliation becomes an ordinary report of working things out. The midnight detail and her remaining discomfort with Saber survive.
